title: Open Banking: privacy notice
text:
This privacy notice describes how HMRC uses your personal information when you use Open Banking to make a payment.

 This policy only relates to the Open Banking payment initiation process. It does not relate to other payment methods, such as when you pay by bank transfer or credit or debit card.

 You should read the HMRC Privacy Notice alongside this privacy notice.
changeNote: The ‘Open Banking privacy notice’ has been updated to include information about the use of Ecospend to verify your identity.
